description: Registry of accepted adapter identities for SynthBench submissions produced via `synthbench submit-adapter`. PRs from this command must match an entry below on (name, version). Adding a new adapter requires a separate maintainer-approved PR — never bundle a registry change with a submission change in the same PR. Legacy submissions (no `adapter` block in run.json) bypass this registry; they are governed by the existing `validate-submissions` job in ci.yml.
